what: Several full-bleed background photos are stacked over the name list. When a name passing the center band of the screen stays for 90ms, its background turns on in .5s cubic-bezier(.33,1,.68,1) and the previous background turns off .15s later in .7s ease. Names sit at .7 normally and only the chosen name goes to 1 (.3s). A name that is hovered or focused wins over the center name, and on release it returns to the center name

options.[data-fx-part=item]: Name line — paired with backgrounds in order (loops back if there are fewer backgrounds)
options.dwell: Time (ms) to wait after the center name changes before changing the background, default 90 — prevents flicker when scrolling fast
options.line: Center band position (% from top of screen), default 50
options.--fx-in · --fx-out · --fx-out-delay · --: On and off durations and off delay, on curve (via style), defaults .5s · .7s · .15s · cubic-bezier(.33,1,.68,1)
options.--fx-dim: Opacity of unselected names (via style), default .7

from.where: index.html .li-authors — four author names and full-bleed portraits
